remarks: This well maintained 1st floor unit has 2 comfortable bedrooms and 1 bathroom. A beautiful hardwood floor run throughout - Large bay windows fill the living room with natural light. Just off the living room is an extra flexible room/space that can serve as a dining room, family room, or whatever you want it to be. Both bedrooms are spacious and bright, making them easy to furnish. Outside the lovely front yard adds to the home's charm. Ready to make this your new home?
